english.note: Use 輕 as the all-purpose adjective for low weight, and also when “light” means gentle or low in intensity.

exampleSentences.english: This bag is really light, so carrying it all day won't make me tired.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個袋好輕，拎住行成日都唔攰。
